title: HSM Gateway: key & certificate rotation, secrets-fallback Terraform module
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Build a reusable Terraform module (hsm_gateway) that provisions an HSM gateway + secrets management bridge for Private/VPC deployments. The module must support: automated asymmetric key and device certificate rotation, health probes for HSM connectivity, a configurable fallback path to cloud KMS/Secrets Manager or Vault when HSM is unreachable, and a Vault secrets-sync controller to keep application secrets consistent. This ticket covers design, implementation, integration tests, and CI/CD pipelines for safe rollout across customer VPCs.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes inputs for HSM endpoints, CA bundle, rotation schedule, and fallback providers
Automated rotation workflow rotates device certs and key wrappers without breaking active sessions in 90% of simulated load tests
Healthcheck Lambda/operator emits metrics (hsm.connectivity, hsm.latency, hsm.error_rate) to Datadog and flips a circuit-breaker flag used by routing policies
Fallback path to cloud KMS/Secrets Manager or Vault is exercised in integration test and preserves read availability within SLOs
Vault sync controller reconciles secrets changes within 30s of upstream update in 3-region test
Module includes example usage for private-1 (single-region) and private-geo (multi-region) layouts and a migration guide
Security review completed and keys never exposed in Terraform state; integration uses encrypted state backend and secrets blinding
Automated plan/apply CI jobs pass with integration test harness in staging environment
rollout_plan: Merge module and lock version; publish to internal registry
Deploy to staging customer VPC with synthetic traffic and enable healthcheck metrics
Run rotation stress test (48h) and validate no more than 1% session failures
Enable fallback policy in staging and simulate HSM outage to verify failover latency < 2s for control-plane operations
Canary on 1 low-risk private customer for 72h with monitoring dashboards and on-call rotation
Gradually increase to 10% of private fleet, then full rollout after 7 days of stable metrics
qa_test_steps: Provision module in ephemeral VPC using terraforming CI; verify resources created: hsm_gateway, rotation_lambda, vault_sync_deployment
Trigger manual cert rotation; confirm new certs exchanged and traffic continues via live load generator
Induce HSM network partition; confirm healthcheck alerts and fallback to cloud KMS; verify secrets read/write paths remain functional
Validate that Terraform state does not contain raw key material and that outputs are ACL-restricted
Run chaos test: kill HSM process and verify Vault sync controller retries and backoff behavior
implementation_notes: Prefer ephemeral signing keys for session tokens; persist only wrapped keys in state
Use a sidecar hsm-proxy container that implements gRPC multiplexing and exposes a lightweight HTTP health endpoint
Rotation orchestrator implemented as step function (or operator) that coordinates cert issuance from CA and HSM key wrapping
Healthchecks include active probe (test sign/verify) and passive metrics (latency, errors) to avoid false positives
Fallback must be toggleable via a feature flag and scoped per-customer deployment; record events in audit log
Design for idempotent Terraform apply so upgrades are safe across partial rollouts

notes_for_reviewers: Please focus reviews on: Terraform state exposure, rotation orchestration correctness, and fallback security posture
We intentionally separate HSM driver into a non-root sidecar to simplify vendor upgrades and CVE patching
If your review suggests large changes to the rotation orchestration, flag early so we can split into follow-up tickets
